case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. The index PPI-D351 changed -3.7 % from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08). On that basis we propose EUR 128.28 per unit, payment 30 days net, valid from 2027-04-01.

Best regards

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. We take great pride in our traditional casting work and the dedicated team here in our region, and we are pleased to present this adjusted offer to you.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the volume change data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We checked the volume forecast data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. In recognition of the increased volume of 8,150 units, we are prepared to reduce our offer to €135.10 per unit. 

For this update, our Angebot stands at a price of €135.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? I am confident that this significant step brings us to a fair agreement for both our houses.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
